abs_export_connection_string.description: Your Azure Blob Storage connection string for exports. Required if `AZURE_BLOB_STORAGE` is the `export_storage_type`

abs_export_container_name.description: Your Azure Blob Storage container name for exports. Required if `AZURE_BLOB_STORAGE` is the `export_storage_type`

abs_export_prefix.description: Your Azure Blob Storage prefix for exports. Used if `AZURE_BLOB_STORAGE` is the `export_storage_type`

cloud_storage_type.description: Cloud storage type Braze Current is connected to.

gcs_bucket.description: Your GCS bucket. Required if `GCS` is the `cloud_storage_type`

gcs_export_bucket.description: Your GCS bucket. Required if `GCS` is the `export_storage_type`

gcs_export_folder.description: Your GCS folder name. Required if `GCS` is the `export_storage_type`

gcs_folder.description: Your GCS folder name. Required if `GCS` is the `cloud_storage_type`

historic_sync_time_frame.description: Range of data in history you would like to include in the initial sync.

historical_sync_limit.title: Historical sync time frame
historical_sync_limit.description: Range of data in history you would like to include in the initial sync. Valid values are `ALL_TIME` and `DATE_LIMIT`

historical_sync_limit_date.title: Historical sync limit date
historical_sync_limit_date.description: The start date (in YYYY-MM-DD) from which to sync historical data. Only used when `historicalSyncLimit` is set to `DATE_LIMIT`.

s3_export_bucket.description: Your S3 user export bucket. Required if `AWS_S3` is the `export_storage_type`

s3_export_folder.description: Your S3 user export folder name. Required if `AWS_S3` is the `export_storage_type`

s3_export_role_arn.description: The Role ARN required for authentication required if `AWS_S3` is the `export_storage_type`

s3bucket.description: Your S3 bucket required if `AWS_S3` is the `cloud_storage_type`

s3folder.description: Your S3 folder name required if `AWS_S3` is the `cloud_storage_type`

s3role_arn.description: The Role ARN required for authentication required if `AWS_S3` is the `cloud_storage_type`
